definitions.cost: Full graph load/setup plus four complete request walls. Incomplete worker recorded time is partial work and excluded from complete-service ratios.
definitions.ratios: Ratios of paired cost sums over whole three-repeat cells; not ratios of medians. All excluded cells/finite pair denominators are explicit.
definitions.medians: Primary cell median/min-max require three completed services; available-completed distributions retain their reduced sample count.
definitions.rss: Process-lifetime high-water bytes; external samples are separate. MiB=bytes/1048576; RSS is never summed.
definitions.request_independence: 24 opinion rows belong to six independent seeded streams; methods and timing repeats are not additional independent inputs.
definitions.interval_scope: Positive integer interval morphology and summed bindings are checked here; mathematical numerical positivity/optimality are not independently re-proved.
definitions.phases: Structural and request phases are exclusive within their service boundaries; overlapping factor/solve metering is diagnostic.
definitions.failures: Missing, not-started, timeout, memory, runtime/certificate errors and unresolved prefixes remain in planned denominators.
